name: Notes on Draenethyst
summary: Azore Aldamort sends you after Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. The Burning Blade warlocks are studying the substance, which came from beyond the Dark Portal.

sections.title: Gimashi's Notes
sections.body: Azore Aldamort says Gimashi's notes may explain what the Burning Blade has learned about draenethyst. Gimashi is a warlock whose tower stands in a ravine to the southeast. You are asked to bring her notes back to Azore, before the Burning Blade can use its knowledge of the substance for darker ends.

faq.answer: Draenethyst is a substance from beyond the Dark Portal.
Gimashi is a Burning Blade warlock studying draenethyst.

faq.q: Why does Azore want Gimashi's notes?
faq.answer: Azore wants Gimashi's notes to learn what the Burning Blade knows about draenethyst.
Gimashi can be found atop her tower in a ravine to the southeast.
Draenethyst came from beyond the Dark Portal.
